description: KNF register (Polish Financial Supervision Authority): licences and entries of a financial company — banks, payment / e-money institutions, investment firms, insurers, lending institutions, agents. Returns entries with kind, KNF number, status, registration / decision / strike-off dates and services. Keyed by NIP; null when the company has no KNF entry.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

title: Get KNF Financial Supervision Register
